entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be routed to the correct department.
Returns.
Connecting you to the Returns department now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. My order number is VF88602.
I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up order VF88602... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on January 11th. That was 17 days ago.
That sounds about right. I'd like to get a return label, please.
I understand. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, could you tell me a bit more about the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's just a preference. The device works fine, but it's not quite what I was looking for. But before you mention the policy, I need to explain something.
Of course, please go ahead.

I know I'm at day 17 now, but I tried to return this on day 9, which was January 20th. I went to your website, but I kept getting a persistent website error on the returns page. It just wouldn't load.
I see. So you attempted to process the return within the 10-day window for the VeloBand Pulse, but a technical issue on our end prevented it?
Exactly. The whole returns portal seemed to be broken. I couldn't print a label or even get to the page to start the process. I have a screenshot of the error message if you need it.
Thank you for providing that detail, and I do apologize for the frustration that must have caused. Let me check our internal system logs for January 20th... one moment.
Okay, thank you for holding. I've just confirmed it. We had a major server issue that afternoon, and our entire system was down, including the returns portal. It's noted here as a critical incident.
I figured it was something like that. So, can we proceed with the return?

Absolutely. Since the fault was on our end, I am more than happy to make an exception and process this return for a full refund. I've just authorized it in the system. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to the email address on file now.

That's great, I appreciate you looking into that. Now, since I had to take the time to save a screenshot and make this call because of the website problem, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for a future purchase, just for the hassle?

I certainly understand your position. While I am not authorized to provide a discount code for this type of situation, I have made sure your return is prioritized. The moment our warehouse scans the item, your full refund will be processed immediately.
Okay, that's fair enough. As long as I'm getting the full refund, that's what matters most. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. The email with the label should be in your inbox. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
